Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 133. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Weapon technique
Ki Cost: 18 ki
Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Melee
Weapon that you are proficient with.
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Self (Weapon reach + 15 foot cone)
Duration: Instantaneous
Chargeable: Yes
By collecting energy in your weapon you can send out
energy facsimiles in a cone in front of you. All creatures
in the cone must make a dexterity saving throw, taking
your weapon die’s damage + 3d8 and creatures are
knocked back to the end of the cone on a failure or half
damage and no weapon effects on a success.
When you would charge this technique, the cone
increases by 5 feet.
